output_list.criticism: The distributeAmounts function has an integer overflow vulnerability, which can be exploited by the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value. This is likely to be true for the distributeAmounts function as it is based on the same logic. The correctness, severity, and profitability scores for this function are all high, with correctness being 8, severity being 9, and profitability being 7.
